title: Staking rewards should be claimed before each `balanceOfNote` changing
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** Medium  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  Since staking rewards depend on `balanceOfNote` the `claimRewards` function should be invoked on each `balanceOfNote` changing. But this functionality is not implemented.
